cards.review_notes: The homepage confirms summer camps only through its booking-link label. Check the iClassPro portal for the actual program name, day-camp format, summer schedule, eligibility, prices, and drop-off venue. No readable 2026 or 2027 program details were available. The current gym address is 1033 Wilcox Court, Kingsport, TN, but no readable current camp listing explicitly identifies its drop-off location; sites are therefore empty.
